messages:
Maya S: quick heads-up — ACME wants to run a 2-week POC next month. requirements: hosted API keys for devs, a dedicated GPU pool for load testing (~200 rps peak), and VPC/private deployment for security review. also need a billing org with spend cap and trial credits while we run it. any blockers? link to excerpt: https://redwood.example/sow/acme-poc
Connor E: @Maya S — for 200 rps we should size the dedicated pool as 4x A100 equiv (estimate). curious re: sequence length and batching targets from their load tests. Do they need streaming?
Maya S: they said chat + embeddings. avg seq ~512 tokens, some long tails to 2048. streaming would be helpful.
Sam Ops: I can handle the billing org + spend cap flow. quick checklist: 1) create billing org + project 2) set trial credit balance on org 3) apply project-level spend cap 4) create ephemeral API keys for devs w/ limited scope. who will own the PO/finance contact?
Nina F: @Sam Ops we need the billing contact and whether they will sign an MSA or want to go card on file. also confirm trial credit amount — typical is $10k for sales-led POCs unless legal requests more.
Jill R: ACME finance contact is Tara Lin (tara@acme.com). they prefer a short SOW + PO. I'll send draft SOW today.
Aria_Sec: Security checklist: they need VPC peering (no public endpoints), KMS integration for keys, audit log retention >=90d, and SOC2 attestation copy. Can we enable account-level audit logs for the POC?
Zack I: For private/VPC we can stand up a dedicated control plane in their VPC with peering, and route inference traffic via private endpoints. Region preference? us-west1 requested. GPU inventory: A100 availability in us-west1 on the requested dates is limited; we could offer an NVLink pool or a mixed-quantized variant to save cost.
Connor E: two practical asks for sizing: a) expected concurrent users (not just rps) b) whether they will run long-running evals that need persistent KV cache. If they need persistent KV we should prefer Dedicated with cache configured.
Maya S: ACME expects ~25 concurrent devs + automated load tests. They will run eval jobs nightly to compare variants.
Sam Ops: OK — I'll provision an org placeholder, attach a project called acme-poc, and set an initial spend cap of $5,000 to limit surprises. We can top up trial credits after PO arrives. I'll also create scoped ephemeral dev API keys (dev role) that expire in 30d.
Nina F: FYI spend cap is a soft guard — for Dedicated we usually require a deposit/commit if they want guaranteed capacity for sustained load. I'll flag that in the SOW.
Aria_Sec: For KMS/key rotation: send me the KMS key arn and we'll configure CMKs in the control plane. Also need confirmation on IP ranges for peering.
Zack I: sample ephemeral key creation curl (internal use):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"project":"acme-poc","role":"dev","expires_in":2592000}'
```
Connor E: +1 on ephemeral keys workflow. For the dedicated pool config I'll propose: 4x A100 equiv, 2x replicas, autoscale burst + fallback to hosted small model. This will allow 200rps bursts and graceful degradation. I'll attach the config tomorrow.
Maya S: can someone own the VPC kickoff with ACME infra? I'll loop in their cloud ops. @Zack I you good to lead the peering plan?
Zack I: I can lead. I'll start a doc and ping their ops for CIDR + peering window.
Jill R: I'll push SOW + PO template to Tara tonight. Also asking them if they can do a fast-path PO to release $10k trial credits earlier.
Sam Ops: Action items: 1) I'll create the billing org placeholder and project (eta: today) 2) set spend cap $5k (can be increased) 3) create ephemeral dev keys for initial devs 4) coordinate with Zack for peering 5) notify finance to expect PO.
Maya S: perfect. please drop updates here. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: org acme-poc created by sam_ops (org_id: org_8h7k)
Sam Ops: org created and initial project provisioned. set spend cap to $5,000 and balance 0. pending PO to release $10k credits.
Nina F: noted on PO path. I'll review SOW and loop legal if needed.
Aria_Sec: I'll prepare the security addendum items they asked for and list the audit artifacts.
Connor E: I'll upload the dedicated pool config and perf estimate in the doc.
Maya S: thanks everyone — moving to onboarding channel for the peering details once Zack has CIDR.
